# Hazard banner (`hazard-banner`)

An unmissable alert for smoke, carbon monoxide, leaks or heat: where, since when, and what to do.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createHazardBanner` (types in `dist/web/home/security/hazardBanner.d.ts`): `.mh-hazard-banner` (`--<kind>`, `--alarm | --warning | --cleared`): an unmissable alert, `role="alert"` untilcleared. A large `__icon`, then `__body` with the `__title` heading, the `__where` line (place and since when)and the `__advice` steps, then `__actions` (the app's actions, Silence, Dismiss). An alarm is filled with thedanger colour and its edge pulses (steady with reduced motion); a warning takes the warning tone; cleared, thesuccess tone.

```ts
export function createHazardBanner(options: HazardBannerOptions): HazardBannerHandle;

export interface HazardBannerOptions {
  kind: HazardKind;
  severity?: HazardSeverity;
  /** The heading (default by kind). */
  title?: string;
  /** Where ("Kitchen", "Utility room, under the sink"). */
  where?: string;
  /** When it started, as the app words it ("10:42", "3 min ago"). */
  since?: string;
  /** What to do: one sentence, or steps. */
  advice?: string | readonly string[];
  /** Extra buttons (Call for help, Shut off water); the app runs them. */
  actions?: readonly HazardAction[];
  /** Offers Silence (the siren is sounding). */
  onSilence?: () => void;
  /** Offers Dismiss (usually once cleared). */
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  onAction?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Level of the heading (default 2). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
  labels?: HazardBannerLabelsInput;
}

export interface HazardBannerHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  update(changes: Partial<HazardBannerOptions>): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createHazardBanner } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const banner = createHazardBanner({
  kind: 'leak',
  where: 'Utility room, under the sink',
  since: '10:42',
  advice: ['Turn off the water at the main valve', 'Move anything that could get wet'],
  actions: [{ id: 'valve', label: 'Shut off water', primary: true }],
  onSilence: () => banner.update({ severity: 'warning', onSilence: undefined }),
  onAction: () =>
    banner.update({
      severity: 'cleared',
      advice: undefined,
      actions: [],
      onSilence: undefined,
      onDismiss: () => banner.el.remove(),
    }),
});

document.body.append(banner.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { HazardBanner } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { HazardSeverity } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function HazardBannerExample() {
  const [severity, setSeverity] = useState<HazardSeverity>('alarm');
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(true);
  if (!shown) return null;
  const cleared = severity === 'cleared';
  return (
    <HazardBanner
      kind="leak"
      severity={severity}
      where="Utility room, under the sink"
      since="10:42"
      advice={cleared ? undefined : ['Turn off the water at the main valve', 'Move anything that could get wet']}
      actions={cleared ? [] : [{ id: 'valve', label: 'Shut off water', primary: true }]}
      onSilence={severity === 'alarm' ? () => setSeverity('warning') : undefined}
      onAction={() => setSeverity('cleared')}
      onDismiss={cleared ? () => setShown(false) : undefined}
    />
  );
}
```
